label: Image or video
help: A GIF, APNG, WebP or WebM with transparency shown on the card. Video plays muted; the alert's sound is the Sound setting.

label: Message
help: Leave empty for the built-in message of each alert (a YouTube follow says subscribed). A message set here is used on every platform; add a platform variation to word one differently. Variables: {name}, {amount} (a Super Chat in your currency, then the viewer's: ≈₹4,180 ($50.00)), {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 1,000 bits), {currency}, {tier}, {months}, {count} (subs gifted), {message} (the viewer's message).

label: Burst window (s, 0 = off)
help: Alerts of the same kind stack into one burst while it is on screen, or when they arrive this close together. A burst plays the sound once. Cheers, raids, Super Chats, Super Stickers and Kicks always play on their own. 0 shows every alert on its own.

label: Burst card time (s)
help: How long each card in a burst stays in front before the next one replaces it. The last card stays for the full alert duration. Large bursts speed up to finish within about 8 seconds more than that.

label: Burst overflow message
help: Heads the last card of a burst too big to show one card per alert, and the card that stands in for a pile-up of cheers, raids, Super Chats, Super Stickers or Kicks. Variables: {count} (alerts not shown), {type} (what a pile-up card counts, named below; empty on a burst's card). Without {type}, a pile-up card shows its name under this line.

label: Cheers name
help: What the card standing in for a pile-up of cheers calls them. Fills {type} in the burst overflow message, or shows under it.

label: Raids name
help: What the card standing in for a pile-up of raids calls them. Fills {type} in the burst overflow message, or shows under it.

label: Super Chats name
help: What the card standing in for a pile-up of Super Chats calls them. Fills {type} in the burst overflow message, or shows under it.

label: Super Stickers name
help: What the card standing in for a pile-up of Super Stickers calls them. Fills {type} in the burst overflow message, or shows under it.

label: Kicks name
help: What the card standing in for a pile-up of Kicks calls them. Fills {type} in the burst overflow message, or shows under it.
